cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening (critical congenital heart disease)

cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening refusal uses a separate CCHD parental refusal form (PDF). Must be stated in writing; the person performing CCHD screening must ensure Maine CDC Maternal and Child Health Program is notified in writing within 5 days. Fax to 207-287-4743.
